cards.text: It's everyone's birthday! The Adventurers' Guild gives every player 100.
A friendly slime ate your purse. Even: it gives you a golden dropping. Odd: it's a friendly slime, it doesn't pay back.
You sold a 'legendary sword'. It was a stick.
You help a villager. To thank you, he gives you a giant white radish wearing tights. It is of no use to you.
The Demon Lord's tax collector comes by: 20 per building you own.
A lost hero asks for directions. Every other player pays you 10 for your map.
Your cart loses a wheel. Go back 3 squares.
Advance to Start and collect your income.
Go straight to the dungeon.
The water goddess blessed you, with too much power: a tidal wave hits the ramparts of every town.
Adventurer's rope. Keep this card: it gets you out of the dungeon for free.
Your boss 'forgot' your bonus. It's a black company, after all.
A mage is practising: a giant explosion echoes over a distant town. Even: a giant chest appears. Odd: a meteor lands on your goods.
A member of a certain police squad invents mayonnaise.
cards.again: A great festive season sweeps the realm.

cards.text: Someone invents the credit card.
cards.again: A wave of demand for credit cards.

cards.text: Someone invents scented soap.
cards.again: A wave of demand for scented soap.

cards.text: Someone invents the printing press.
cards.again: A wave of demand for printed books.

cards.text: An earthquake shakes a town.
The Hollow Company spilled a strange liquid over a town.
A dragon was playing 'who can shoot the farthest' and hit a town by accident.
Demons invade a town.
A self-proclaimed water goddess starts a riot in the streets.
A stampede of flying cabbages crosses a town.
An epidemic hits the capital: a cure must be found.
The miners of Overtime Hollow go on strike.
Harvest festival in Greenhorn Fields.
The curse. Roll a die: even, you may keep it; odd, play it now on another player.
A mimic eats your clothes. An elf mage dressed all in white saves you.
A treasure chest. Even: it's full. Odd: it's empty.
You escort a saint. You pray with her... and fall asleep. You lose this turn, then you are out.
Goblins steal your purse, but they leave behind a magazine of virtual idols from an unknown world.
The healer, a macho in sunglasses, hands you his bill and asks you to pray to Mitama.
You find the way out.
You got lost. You stay until the end of your time inside.
You hung out with adventurers. Draw an Event card.
